description: DFX's own published research records and investigations: each finding with its permanent id, version, as-of date, denominator, method link, sources and citation line. With record_id, the evidence manifest: every claim with its basis (reported, DFX calculation, DFX inference) and source. A record with a correction pending has its statements withheld. ACCESS: without a paid DFX plan on the vertical, a list returns its first 5 rows in full and a count of the rest by type (locked.count, locked.by_type), never the rows; a record names its subject and the first 3 related names per section; contact values (email, phone, profile URLs) and decision-maker names are never returned, only their types and counts. Every answer says what it withheld in `entitlement` and `locked`. Full access: DFX Intelligence, 7 days free at https://dfxintel.com/data-factory/plans.

kind.description: original_finding: DFX computed or connected it. announcement_with_dfx_context: a third party announced it and DFX added context.

query.description: Words that must all appear in a finding's title, finding or categories (case ignored).

record_id.description: One research record id, DFX-RESEARCH-YYYY-NNNN: returns its entry and evidence manifest.
